column1: # Held-out US-location set 2 (2026-11-12): 170 distinct (board location string,
# remote flag) pairs, 160 distinct strings (10 drawn once with each remote
# flag; header corrected 2026-11-12, it said 170 distinct strings), from the
# live ledger (7,606 distinct strings over 69,024 postings), none in
# us_oracle.tsv or us_heldout.tsv, drawn AFTER the per-option change by a
# seeded sample (seed 20261112) with probability proportional to each
# string's posting count (Efraimidis-Spirakis, without replacement), so the
# plain mean over rows estimates a posting-level rate. Hand-labelled from a
# sheet holding only the string and the remote flag: no verdict column.
# Columns, tab-separated: label, remote, location, stratum, postings.
#   label  U: every option the string lists is in the United States (or Puerto
#             Rico); M: some option is and some is not; N: none is; A: as
#             likely US as not, unresolvable from the string; ?: no place.
#          A remote role listed at a place is remote within that place.
